# biobb_pdb_tools

### Introduction
Biobb_pdb_tools is a swiss army knife for manipulating and editing PDB files. Biobb (BioExcel building blocks) packages are Python building blocks that create new layer of compatibility and interoperability over popular bioinformatics tools.
The latest documentation of this package can be found in our readthedocs site:
[latest API documentation](http://biobb-pdb-tools.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
